name: SA energy bill concession
summary: Yearly credit on your electricity bill for South Australians on Youth Allowance, Austudy, ABSTUDY or with a Low Income Health Care Card.
who: Have an energy account in your name, listed first on the bill
Hold an eligible card (such as a Low Income Health Care Card) or receive an eligible payment such as Youth Allowance, Austudy or ABSTUDY
how: Apply with the online household concessions form, a paper form, or by calling ConcessionsSA on 1800 307 758.
Have your Centrelink CRN, latest electricity and water bills and bank details ready.
catches: The amount is indexed each financial year and paid as a daily rate, so each bill's credit varies.

evidence.claim: Eligible payments include Youth Allowance and Austudy
